text_description: Full-length runway look built around a dark navy-black, longline tailored coat worn as the top layer over matching dark trousers. The coat has a slim, elongated silhouette with neat set-in shoulders, a pointed shirt-style collar, long narrow sleeves ending around the wrist, and a visible center-front button placket fastening from the collar down through the torso. It is close-cut through the upper body and waist, then falls straight with a slight flare to below the knee/upper calf; the front opens below the lower buttons into a long central split, revealing the trousers in motion. The surface appears matte and softly textured, suggesting a dense woven or brushed fabric, with tonal seams and minimal decoration. Underneath, the trousers are dark, fluid, and full-length with a relaxed straight-to-wide leg, breaking over the shoes and adding volume beneath the sharper coat. Footwear is visible only at the front: muted taupe-brown, low-profile shoes or boots with an elongated rounded-to-pointed toe, partly covered by the trouser hem. Styling is minimal and austere, with center-parted straight hair tucked back, no visible jewelry, no bag, and a restrained monochrome palette that emphasizes clean tailoring, vertical lines, and a sober fall runway mood.
key_elements: pointed shirt collar and center-front buttons
slim shoulders and long narrow sleeves
below-knee coat length with front split opening
minimal styling with no visible accessories
uncertainty_notes: Exact fabric content is not visible; surface only appears matte and softly textured.
Footwear type is partly obscured by the trouser hem.
